verdicts.evidence: Dropping the `^` makes any filename ENDING in a wrangler manifest name a manifest. Measured on a project holding `my-wrangler.toml` and `notwrangler.json` beside the real manifests: the mutant read both, found they declare the same entry, and added an `ambiguous` note — `more than one manifest declares \`src/c.ts\` as its entry` — that the delivered code does not produce. A decoy file becomes evidence.

verdicts.evidence: Dropping the `$` makes any filename STARTING with a manifest name a manifest. Measured on the same project: `wrangler.toml.bak` and `wrangler.tomlish` were both picked up, parsed as JSON (neither ends in .toml) and produced two `unread` notes the delivered code never emits — a backup file lands in the couldNotRead fail-loud list.
